source.title: District-wise general fertilizer recommendations for major crops in India
source.documentReleaseIdentifier: 03062026 in official distribution URL; exact publication date not printed
source.scope: Annexure 1, Bihar district standard doses, printed pp.10–11. Background p.2: district aggregates derived from STCR framework/SHC data, not an executable field STCR model. No timing. Rice FYM credit note is not applied automatically.
source.organicCreditNote: Bihar Rice note: 5 t FYM/ha permits source-stated nutrient credits. Material/application applicability must be confirmed; no credit is assumed in the full standard preview.

records.doseScope: ICAR general district nutrient recommendation; not a soil-test adjustment or field-specific STCR calculation
records.conditions: ICAR 2026 district-wise general rate for Saran wheat, Rabi. Source does not provide timing or field-specific soil adjustment. DAP/urea/MOP quantities, if calculated, are arithmetic estimates from standard product grades, not an ICAR product prescription.
